content.short: Animated NFT artwork living inside the Pixelverse.
content.description:
The Pixel Head Squad is a two part Cardano NFT project. Pixel Heads are 1/1 unique, reactive/evolutive avatars. Each NFT comes with a unique back story, and can react or evolve based on time or interaction. Pixel Squad is a planned, large scale release of an undetermined number of different characters from all of the species within the Pixelverse.

Currently Pixel Heads are animated artwork or display pictures. However, we have already begun work on the roadmap/concept stage of the Pixelverse. Our plan is to use proceeds from the Pixel Head & Pixel Squad releases to fund development of our corner of the Metaverse at large.
